reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in her direct message to confirm I've noted the new 7 July cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork and will keep it between us.

I first tried to send it as a new direct message by her name, but the directory didn't recognise "Ilse Varga". I posted the reply in the existing conversation she wrote from instead.

I didn't save the date to the shared knowledge base, because other people can read it and she asked to keep this private. I took no other action, since she said none was needed.
